title: Enablement rollout plan for Standard Demo v1 (training, certification, comms, asset links)
project: Standard Demo v1 / Demo Tenant + Talk Track
creator: Talia Benson
description:
Goal
Stand up a repeatable field rollout for “Redwood Standard Demo v1” so AEs/SEs can run a reliable demo from the shared demo tenant with consistent messaging, minimal prep, and a clear escalation path.

Scope
- Training session agenda(s) + calendar plan
- Certification checklist + lightweight “pass/fail” criteria for demo readiness
- Single hub of links to all demo assets (deck, talk track, runbook, reset checklist, scenario scripts, security FAQ)
- Comms plan (email + Slack announcement) and ongoing office hours
- Metrics + ownership for keeping enablement current (release cadence, what triggers re-cert)

Non-goals
- New product features (tracked in ENG tickets)
- Full POC framework or bespoke vertical demos

Audience
- Solutions Engineers (primary drivers)
- Account Executives (narration + discovery, can run the 2-minute hosted mini-demo)
- Sales leadership (pipeline hygiene + required usage)
- Partner team (secondary: “how to reuse assets” guidance)

Proposed rollout phases
1) Pilot enablement (NA + EMEA champions)
- 1 training session with live dry-run
- 3–5 “certified” drivers in each region
- Collect feedback + patch missing doc gaps

2) General Availability for field
- Publish links + comms
- Require certification for demo tenant access (SE) and/or for “Standard Demo v1” meeting type in CRM
- Start office hours + weekly dry-runs for 4 weeks

3) Sustain
- Monthly refresh (or per major product release impacting demo)
- Quarterly recertification (or on major talk track changes)

Training plan
A) 60-minute live training (SE-first)
- 0:00–0:05 Context + what’s new
  - Why: reduce ad-hoc SE heroics, improve demo reliability
  - What: demo tenant + known-good scenarios + talk track branches
- 0:05–0:15 Narrative overview (PMM-led)
  - Persona framing: Platform Eng vs ML Eng vs Security
  - What we show live vs what we claim (guardrails)
- 0:15–0:40 Live demo walkthrough (SE-led)
  - Scenario order: (1) streaming chat + time-to-first-token, (2) cost controls dashboard, (3) routing + fallback + “graceful degradation”, (4) observability (errors/traces) and rollouts
  - Dedicated/Private pivots: when to switch the narrative, what to avoid live
- 0:40–0:50 Troubleshooting + plan B
  - If dashboards lag, if streaming disconnects, if output variance occurs
  - Reset checklist overview + pre-demo verification
- 0:50–0:60 Q&A + next steps
  - Certification steps
  - Where to file issues + business-hours paging path

B) 30-minute AE training (narration + discovery)
- How to open, qualify, and choose scenario order
- Safe claims + how to handle “numbers” questions (use ranges, defer specifics)
- How to tee up next step: evaluation/trial vs prospect-specific tenant

C) Weekly office hours (first 4 weeks post-launch)
- 45 minutes
- Agenda: top issues, show-and-tell of best calls, fast re-cert, questions

Certification checklist (SE “Driver”)
- Access + environment
  - Can login to demo tenant (SSO) and reach Console
  - Knows where to find/reset quotas + seed data
  - Can verify health dashboards are green before the call
- Core scenarios (must pass)
  - Run Scenario 1 (Hosted API streaming) end-to-end from script with expected behavior
  - Show cost/latency breakdown in Console and narrate levers (batching/caching/quantization profiles at a high level)
  - Demonstrate routing/fallback policy and explain what happens under constraint
  - Navigate to saved views: latency, cost, errors (and interpret at least one panel)
- Messaging + guardrails
  - Uses approved “what we show vs what we claim” language
  - Can handle top 5 objections (latency realism, cost realism, nondeterminism, data retention/logging, Dedicated vs Private distinctions)
- Failure modes
  - Can execute the Plan B path within 60 seconds (switch to canned outputs / screenshots / prerecorded clip as needed)

Certification method
- Record a 10–12 minute Loom (or attend live check) with the “standard path” demo
- Reviewer: Markus Klein (primary) or regional SE lead delegate
- Valid for 90 days or until “talk track major version bump”

Asset hub (single source of truth)
- Canonical links to publish in rollout comms:
  - Confluence: Standard Demo Deck v1 (slide intent + screenshot requirements)
    - sources/confluence/sales-enablement/pitch-decks/demo-deck-standard-v1.json
  - Confluence: Master talk track script (persona branches)
    - sources/confluence/sales-enablement/positioning-and-messaging/demo-talk-track-master-script.json
  - Confluence: Demo tenant setup runbook
    - sources/confluence/eng-developer-experience/quickstarts-and-templates/demo-tenant-setup-runbook.json
  - Confluence: Demo dashboards + alerts
    - sources/confluence/eng-platform/runbooks/demo-tenant-dashboards-alerts.json
  - Confluence: Demo tenant security FAQ
    - sources/confluence/sales-enablement/security-faq/demo-tenant-security-faq.json
  - Drive: Working deck + speaker notes (latest)
    - sources/google_drive/shared_drives/go-to-market/Deck - Redwood Standard Demo (Working).json
    - sources/google_drive/shared_drives/go-to-market/Talk Track - Redwood Standard Demo (Speaker Notes).json
  - Drive: Demo scenarios matrix + reset checklist
    - sources/google_drive/shared_drives/go-to-market/Demo Scenarios - Known Good Matrix.json
    - sources/google_drive/shared_drives/go-to-market/Demo Tenant Reset Checklist.json

Comms plan
- Launch email (Field Enablement + Sales leadership)
  - Include: what changed, who should attend training, links to assets, certification requirement, office hours schedule
  - Source draft exists:
    - sources/google_drive/shared_drives/go-to-market/Field Enablement Email + LMS Outline.json
- Slack announcement in #sales and #general
  - TL;DR + link hub + office hours + how to request updates

CRM workflow alignment (coordinate with Isabelle Laurent)
- Add internal guidance: “Use Standard Demo v1 when…” vs “Spin up prospect-specific trial when…”
- Add a meeting type/tag: “Standard Demo v1” (optional) to enable tracking demo-to-eval conversion

Metrics / success criteria
- 80% of SEs in NA/EMEA certified within 4 weeks of GA
- Demo reliability: <2% demo calls with tenant-related failure requiring reschedule (tracked via lightweight form or Slack emoji + triage label)
- Demo-to-eval conversion improves vs baseline (Sales Ops to define baseline window)

Owners
- Enablement rollout lead: Renee Sullivan
- SE readiness/cert reviewer: Markus Klein
- Deck/talk track: Soojin Lee
- Demo tenant runbook / oncall path: Rafael Mendes + Sean Gallagher (oversight)
- CRM guidance: Isabelle Laurent

Open questions
- Do we gate demo tenant access on certification (SSO group) or just strongly recommend? Proposal: gate “driver” access to prod demo tenant routes; allow read-only for observers.
- EMEA data residency asks: do we add an EU-only “safe path” slide + talk track branch in v1 or v1.1? (Need input from Lukas Meyer + Platform).

Risks
- Field runs stale assets (old talk track, broken scripts). Mitigation: single hub link + version pinning policy (ADR) + monthly refresh reminder.
- Overpromising on benchmarks. Mitigation: use approved ranges and avoid hard numbers in live demo; link to benchmark proof points table for internal use only.
